newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt says Israel insensitive about settlement.
newsitem.headline: Egypt says Israel insensitive about settlement.

text.p: Egypt said on Sunday it would be insensitive and damaging for Israel to break ground on a Jewish settlement in East Jerusalem after so much Arab protest.
"Israeli insistence will lead to the direst consequences," Foreign Minister Amr Moussa told reporters.

"If a decision is taken to start building the settlement, this means the Israeli leadership has no sensitivity to the negative effects on the peace process, the danger of defying Arab and world public opinion or of breaking international law and the (peace) agreements in this outrageous way," he added.
"It can only do extreme damage to the general atmosphere surrounding the peace process."

Israel's deputy housing minister, Meir Porush, said on Sunday that Israel would break ground on the Jewish settlement at Abu Ghneim hill on Monday, despite a conciliatory visit to Israel by King Hussein of Jordan and police warnings that the project threatened to provoke Palestinian violence.
"The government's decision stands and will be executed," added Foreign Minister David Levy, speaking on army radio.
